title: These things look great, but their performance isn't so great
text: These things look great, but their performance isn't so great. I tried cutting some shrink wrapped steak with them.  They work ok sometimes, othertimes its likeI got some lefty's in my hand and instead of cutting the material, the blades just skirt it.  Ok for lighter material, like chip bags and some packaging, but for heavier/thicker stuff it's not as good as I had hoped.
